fixes.summary: Move host bootstrap delivery to immutable content-addressed S3 assets.
Preserve tenant suspend and resume behavior across control-plane updates.
Keep published Python dependency metadata internally consistent.
Carry forward lifecycle reconciliation corrections.
Complete the rebuild lifecycle fence and host-side rebuild transaction.
Update the default host image build contract.
Carry forward verified canary and control-plane behavior.
Converge tenant suspend and resume state transitions.
Move the console to the BFF path and converge private API networking.
Add heterogeneous host capacity profiles and affinity-aware scheduling.
Make Fluent Bit keyring installation non-interactive and repeatable.
Preserve live host capacity counters when init-host is rerun.
Run host-agent with unbuffered Python logging.
Converge rebuild authorization, dispatch, query, and health behavior.
Restore tenant query fields including rootfs and health metrics.
Keep image build and schema checks compatible with the public release.
Deliver the Packer golden AMI workflow.
Remove internal issue references from published checks.
Carry forward envelope, host build, and runtime configuration fixes.
Use the customer-managed LiteLLM gateway contract.
Default rebuilds to the live image channel and fail closed on empty slots.
Make reset operations token-idempotent with host-side transactional cleanup.
Correct first-deploy capacity defaults and lifecycle timeout guidance.

params_changed.name: asg.min_capacity -> HostASG.MinSize
params_changed.runtime_impact: First-deploy guidance only. Applying zero to a live fleet permits scale-in to zero and is not performed by this kit.

params_changed.name: asg.lifecycle_hook_timeout -> InitHook.HeartbeatTimeout
params_changed.runtime_impact: Extends the launch lifecycle wait ceiling without changing running instances.

fixes.summary: Allow a new tenant-query table to create all required indexes at once.

verifications.action: Decode LaunchTemplateVersions[0].LaunchTemplateData.UserData for the in-service host template and extract every deployment/bootstrap/host/<64-hex> prefix.
verifications.observable: The decoded UserData bootstrap prefix and any remaining double-brace placeholder marker.
verifications.pass_when: The only bootstrap prefix equals this kit's target asset prefix and the decoded UserData contains no unrendered placeholder marker.
verifications.fail_when: The decoded template still names the prior bootstrap prefix, contains a second prefix, or includes an unrendered placeholder marker.
verifications.cleanup: Remove only the exact test tenant ids, operation ids, instance ids, S3 object keys, and temporary paths recorded by this verification; never use prefix or wildcard deletion.

verifications.action: Suspend one recorded test tenant, read its openclaw-tenants row, restore the same tenant id, and read the row again.
verifications.observable: The action response status plus openclaw-tenants attributes status, restore_backup_key, host_id, and vm_num.
verifications.pass_when: Suspend returns status=suspended with a nonempty restore_backup_key, then restore returns the same tenant id with status=running and a populated host_id and vm_num.
verifications.fail_when: Suspend reaches suspended without a backup key, restore creates a different tenant identity, or the final row is not running on a recorded host slot.
verifications.cleanup: Remove only the exact test tenant ids, operation ids, instance ids, S3 object keys, and temporary paths recorded by this verification; never use prefix or wildcard deletion.

verifications.action: Read project.requires-python from pyproject.toml and requires-python from uv.lock, then compare the root package version metadata.
verifications.observable: pyproject.toml requires-python and version values alongside uv.lock requires-python and the root package version.
verifications.pass_when: Both files declare requires-python >=3.12 and the locked root package version equals pyproject.toml version 1.5.5.
verifications.fail_when: The Python constraints differ, the root package is absent from uv.lock, or its locked version is not 1.5.5.
verifications.cleanup: Remove only the exact test tenant ids, operation ids, instance ids, S3 object keys, and temporary paths recorded by this verification; never use prefix or wildcard deletion.

verifications.action: Parse docs/aws-guide/openapi.yaml and inspect the tenant action operation request and response schemas for rebuild lifecycle reconciliation.
verifications.observable: The tenant action schema properties client_token and image_channel plus documented 403, 409, 502, and 503 response codes.
verifications.pass_when: The OpenAPI operation exposes client_token and image_channel and documents explicit 403, 409, 502, and 503 outcomes for lifecycle reconciliation.
verifications.fail_when: Either request field is absent or a lifecycle conflict, host failure, or unavailable response is missing from the operation contract.
verifications.cleanup: Remove only the exact test tenant ids, operation ids, instance ids, S3 object keys, and temporary paths recorded by this verification; never use prefix or wildcard deletion.

verifications.action: Invoke one tenant rebuild as a non-administrator and repeat it as an administrator while recording HTTP status, code, op_id, and rebuild_status.
verifications.observable: The tenant action HTTP status and JSON fields code, op_id, status, and rebuild_status.
verifications.pass_when: The non-administrator receives 403 code=ACCESS_DENIED, while the administrator receives synchronous 200 with status=running and rebuild_status=done or explicit 503 code=REBUILD_RETRY_PENDING.
verifications.fail_when: A non-administrator can start the rebuild, the administrator receives 202 Accepted, or a 503 response omits its retry code and operation identity.
verifications.cleanup: Remove only the exact test tenant ids, operation ids, instance ids, S3 object keys, and temporary paths recorded by this verification; never use prefix or wildcard deletion.

verifications.action: Read OPENCLAW_PIN and OPENCLAW_NODE_MIN from build-rootfs.sh and run the template schema gate against the baked openclaw.json input.
verifications.observable: The pinned OpenClaw version, Node.js minimum, schema-gate exit code, and schema-gate success line.
verifications.pass_when: OPENCLAW_PIN is 2026.7.1-2, the Node.js version meets OPENCLAW_NODE_MIN, and the schema gate exits 0 for the baked template.
verifications.fail_when: The pin differs from 2026.7.1-2, Node.js is below the declared minimum, or the gate reports a forbidden template key.
verifications.cleanup: Remove only the exact test tenant ids, operation ids, instance ids, S3 object keys, and temporary paths recorded by this verification; never use prefix or wildcard deletion.

verifications.action: Rebuild a recorded tenant onto a host whose openclaw-hosts image_slots.canary entry is READY, then read the tenant row and host slot metadata.
verifications.observable: The rebuild response plus openclaw-tenants image_channel and image_snapshot_time matched to openclaw-hosts image_slots.canary.
verifications.pass_when: The rebuild completes with image_channel=canary and image_snapshot_time exactly equal to the selected host's READY canary snapshot.
verifications.fail_when: The tenant remains on live, records a snapshot other than the host canary value, or the action reports success before the canary adoption is recorded.
verifications.cleanup: Remove only the exact test tenant ids, operation ids, instance ids, S3 object keys, and temporary paths recorded by this verification; never use prefix or wildcard deletion.

verifications.action: Send two concurrent suspend requests for one recorded tenant, wait for a terminal row, then send two concurrent restore requests and read host counters.
verifications.observable: openclaw-tenants status transitions and openclaw-hosts used_vcpu, used_mem_mb, and vm_count before and after each concurrent pair.
verifications.pass_when: Each concurrent pair converges to one terminal state, suspended then running, and host capacity is released and reacquired exactly once.
verifications.fail_when: The tenant remains suspending or restoring, two slots are released or reserved, or any host counter becomes negative or double-incremented.
verifications.cleanup: Remove only the exact test tenant ids, operation ids, instance ids, S3 object keys, and temporary paths recorded by this verification; never use prefix or wildcard deletion.

verifications.action: Read the CloudFront distribution cache behaviors and the console's actual BFF URL, then query the private REST API endpoint configuration.
verifications.observable: CloudFront CacheBehaviors path patterns and origins, the console HTTP status, and get-rest-api endpointConfiguration.types and vpcEndpointIds.
verifications.pass_when: The console BFF path returns a successful response, no console or chat behavior targets the static origin, and the REST API is PRIVATE with a nonempty vpcEndpointIds list.
verifications.fail_when: The console path returns 404, a console or chat behavior still selects the static origin, or the REST API endpoint configuration has no VPC endpoint id.
